description: Test file for channel activity module, testing recording and retrieval of channel activity timestamps and account handling logic.

methods.name: getChannelActivity
methods.description: Retrieves the last inbound and outbound timestamps for a given channel and account.

methods.name: recordChannelActivity
methods.description: Records an inbound or outbound activity timestamp for a specific channel and account.

methods.name: resetChannelActivityForTest
methods.description: Resets the activity data to initial state for testing.
